name: EURAU
who_can_redeem: Verified institutions may acquire and redeem at par under AllUnity onboarding and MiCAR terms; broader secondary holders retain applicable EMT redemption rights subject to issuer terms.
redemption_region_notes: Primary issuance is restricted to verified institutions under issuer onboarding controls.
redemption_notes: AllUnity whitepaper states EURAU is issued at par after receipt of funds and is a MiCAR electronic-money token denominated 1:1 in euro.
summary: AllUnity-issued fully reserved euro electronic-money token launched under a BaFin EMI licence and subsequently expanded across multiple networks.
notes: Batch 038 draft. Current exact reserve allocation and full deployment inventory are kept to primary-confirmed records only.

name: Eurite
who_can_redeem: Holders may request redemption from Banking Circle at par subject to customer-due-diligence checks.
redemption_region_notes: Direct issuer interaction is subject to Banking Circle due-diligence and regulatory restrictions.
redemption_notes: Banking Circle states EURI is fully redeemable at par without a redemption fee and backed 1:1 by euro cash held in segregated safeguarded funds.
summary: Banking Circle S.A.-issued MiCA-regulated euro electronic-money token backed 1:1 by euro cash and launched on Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain.
notes: Batch 038 draft. Banking Circle issuer, euro peg, safeguarding and redemption are primary-confirmed.

name: EURQ

redemption_notes: Quantoz states EMT holders have the right of redemption against the issuer at any time and at par.
summary: Quantoz Payments B.V.-issued MiCA-compliant euro electronic-money token used for regulated digital payments and settlement.
notes: Batch 038 draft. Ethereum, Polygon, Algorand, Xahau/XRPL and Stellar deployment claims will be normalized only where primary identifiers are explicit.
